[5] DIAGNOSTIC BOUNDARIES & OPEN HYPOTHESES
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  1. BOUNDARY (CopyResource): Because [READBACK_SRC] is already 100% black (all zeros) before CopyResource, a 100% black backbuffer in [READBACK] does NOT validate CopyResource transfer fidelity (copying zeros onto zeros is indistinguishable from a no-op). It DOES prove the black output originates upstream on the source RTV prior to CopyResource.
  2. HYPOTHESIS (Zero fragment output / black inputs): Executed RTV draw calls prove command invocation, not non-zero pixel writes. The PS overrides may be reading unbound/black SRVs (t0..tn), zeroed Constant Buffers (b0..bn), or the second alternating draw may overwrite the first draw's output with black.
